items.description: A Corewar implementation in Go with assembly language support — includes an assembler and virtual machine for competitive code battles.
Our own version of the 1984 game CoreWar. We have to code our own assembler and virtual machine.
Assembly parser, machine code transcribing and Virtual Machine executing!
Make Robots coded in Assembly fight in a Virtual Machine coded in C for Memory
code VS code combat in a fun-sized virtual machine!
Translator from assembly language into machine code

this is the program that will compile your champions and translate them from the language you will write them in (assembly language) into “Bytecode”.Bytecode is a machine code, which will be directly interpreted by the virtual machine.

42 project Corewar. Requirements are: writing a player (champion) in language inspired by assembly; writing an assembler for translating a champion written in assembly into a byte-code; writing a virtual machine that can execute the byte-code generated by assembler.
Getting Started with Coding August 20th, the current state of the project is the development of a virtual machine architecture

An advanced C project, and entry into the even lower level language, assembly. A Virtual Machine created to run up to 4 simple assembly programs in the same memory space, and an assembler to compile Corewar Assembly code into byte code.
